normalization.tokenization: split on non-alphanumeric; decompose snake/kebab/camel identifiers; deduplicate preserving first occurrence

lexical_arms.name: v1-bm25-baseline
lexical_arms.scorer: existing ToolCatalog BM25; baseline implementation unchanged

lexical_arms.name: signal-v2-field-weighted-bm25
lexical_arms.scorer: BM25F: for each term, qtf=sum(query_field_weight*term_frequency); weighted_tf=sum(descriptor_field_weight*term_frequency/(1-b+b*field_length/field_average_length)); score=sum(IDF*qtf*(k1+1)*weighted_tf/(k1+weighted_tf)); field averages are per-field means over the case candidate universe; empty fields contribute zero

lexical_arms.name: signal-v2-normalized-bm25
lexical_arms.scorer: BM25 constants above; unique normalized tokens each count once

semantic_arms.name: signal-v2-flat
semantic_arms.query: unlabelled RetrievalQueryV2 field values in frozen field order

semantic_arms.name: signal-v2-field-labelled-descriptor
semantic_arms.query: unlabelled RetrievalQueryV2 field values in frozen field order

spec.semantic_scoring: Cross each semantic arm with both pooling variants. Encode query and descriptor independently using CandleBertSequenceEncoder::encode_context(text, pooling), whose token budget is MAX_PAIR_TOKENS=256. L2-normalize vectors, rank cosine dot product descending, and tie-break canonical_name ascending.

encoder_asset.verification: ResolvedAssets validates manifest SHA-256 for config, vocabulary, weights, and license; no network or download path

spec.encoder_tokenizer_version: all-MiniLM-L6-v2@1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41 plus verified manifest hashes for config/vocabulary/weights
spec.surface_fingerprint: SHA-256 over sorted (canonical_name, disclosure, descriptor_fingerprint_v2) tuples for every candidate in the expanded case universe; query fields are excluded
spec.cache_contents: descriptor embeddings only; query embeddings are never cached
spec.authority: rank only candidates already present and deferred in the frozen expanded universe; no candidate creation, filtering, or authority decision
spec.selection: best per-arm operating point uses smallest K, then lower p95 latency, then lower descriptor bytes/cache size, then lexical mode name; no post-hoc variants or parameter changes
